title: devlaunch CLI --json envelope
description: The shape of every devlaunch command's --json output. See docs/agent-contract.md.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only on a breaking change to this shape.

code.description: "OK" on success. On failure, a stable error-catalog code (e.g. PORT_IN_USE).

message.description: One human-readable sentence, safe to print as-is.

hint.description: What to do next. On failure, the catalog entry's agentHint.

data.description: Command-specific payload. Never contains secret values.
